verdict.rationale: Segment provides general privacy tooling (Privacy Portal, Consent Management, GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance) and even markets 'AI-powered audiences,' making the question of AI-training data controls plausible for this product category, but no evidence describes any mechanism to specifically opt customer data out of AI/ML model training. Consent Management docs address cookie/data-collection consent broadly, not AI training use specifically.
